# G11 — tags rendered as [[a, b]] (nested list) in logs

**Section**: G. Playbook & knowledge
**Keywords**: brackets, build_notes, defensively, digest, flattens, join, kept, knowledge, lines, list, logs, nested, parse_digest, parser, playbook, re-added, rendered, square, strips, surrounding, tags, them, tooling, yaml

## Problem

tags rendered as [[a, b]] (nested list) in logs

## Root cause

digest parser kept the square brackets from 'tags: [a, b]' lines; join re-added them

## Solution

parse_digest strips surrounding brackets; build_notes flattens nested tags defensively
